task_description: Full mobile UI/UX redesign to Netflix-style with dedicated Browse page (Genre/Country tabs replacing Search in bottom nav), multi-language support (7 languages) with auto-detection on mobile and language dropdown in header for both mobile and web apps.

All 7 locale files across mobile and web have identical key structures (68 keys each, including new downloads.emptyState). Review fixes applied: getDiscoverByGenre API method added, genre detail screens fixed, locale added to mobile query keys, downloads empty state localized, home rail titles fully translated.
